name: rivet
description: Rivet compiler diagnostics, quick fixes, resume hints and route links for TSX, plus Rivet: Doctor.

rivet.inlayHints.description: Resume inlay hints: browser-only closures (client), every resume site (all), or none. Shown by the extension itself (independent of typescript.inlayHints.*); editor.inlayHints.enabled still applies.

rivet.typeAware.description: Type-aware checks: warn on internal links that match no route (RV3101).

rivet.regions.description: Tint code by where it runs on a resumed page: browser only vs server and browser.
